status: Offline numeric attribution of completed ordinary independent-log comparison (historical variant label lazy means independent-log candidate); no new CLI or Cloud commands
limits: Only main-client numeric phase records are used for foreground attribution.
Cloud flush covers pending exports plus the refresh-file gate; it is not network RTT or server-processing timing.
The residual outside the shutdown handler includes work and CLI cleanup; it is not a pure engine query duration.
CPU/GC deltas use wider pre/post snapshots and include background work; completed GC count is not causal proof.
File visibility is sampled every 5 ms; it is not exact generator-return timing.
Main shutdown records come from Docker completion timestamps; phase duration is recorded by the engine monotonic clock.
One cold pair and few warm pairs are insufficient for stable performance distributions.
